name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.channel.blackwhite.QChatBlackWhiteActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen when a user manages a channel's allow or block list. It shows the relevant list and lets the user add or remove members.
disableEffect: Users cannot change the channel's member allow or block list through the built-in QChat screen.
